bug_semantics: MoneyPrinterTurbo mounts V1 video routes at prefix /api/v1. download_video is GET /download/{file_path:path} and therefore reachable as /api/v1/download/<file_path>. The handler takes the raw URL path parameter and builds video_path = os.path.join(utils.task_dir(), file_path) with no confinement, then returns FileResponse(path=video_path). FastAPI's :path converter preserves a leading slash, so the advisory URI /api/v1/download//etc/passwd supplies file_path=/etc/passwd; on POSIX os.path.join(tasks_dir, '/etc/passwd') discards the task directory and yields /etc/passwd. Relative ../ sequences likewise escape the intended storage root. The same unsanitized join existed on sibling stream_video, but CVE-2025-49089 names the download URI. The flaw is present at tag v1.2.6 (download_video still uses os.path.join(tasks_dir, file_path)).
flaw_origin: The download surface was first written in 00052b4c503745ccefeb6241fe6b4cbc29e165c6 ('chore: add video download api endpoint', 2024-04-15) as a 20-line addition of download_video that copied the unsanitized os.path.join(tasks_dir, file_path) pattern already used by stream_video. That commit is a single-parent, non-merge, non-squash first write of the vulnerable download lines; the parent tree has /stream/{file_path:path} but no /download/{file_path:path} and no download_video. The later 18f5e478979bbb2606b1711289d410f89b1cffe9 fix replaced the join with _resolve_path_within_directory (realpath + commonpath confinement) and is the first tag member in v1.2.7.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: CVE-2025-49089 / GHSA-p63x-hq5f-7f58 is a published CWE-22 on GET /api/v1/download/{file_path:path}. In v1.2.6 the handler concatenates the attacker-controlled path onto utils.task_dir() with os.path.join and serves the result via FileResponse, so an absolute segment such as /etc/passwd (the extra slash in /api/v1/download//etc/passwd) or ../ traversal reads files outside the task directory. The CVE.org record is PUBLISHED, NVD has analyzed it against harry0703:moneyprinterturbo:1.2.6, and the GitHub advisory is not withdrawn, so this is not a false positive even though the referenced gist is a broken link. BIC: git log -L/:download_video and -S 'download/{file_path' both first hit 00052b4c503745ccefeb6241fe6b4cbc29e165c6, a 20-line single-parent commit that introduced the download route and the unsanitized join. Parent d13a3cf6e911d1573c62b1f6459c3c0b7a1bc18d was checked directly: the download route and download_video are absent from that tree (stream_video already had the same join, but that is a sibling surface, not this advisory's download URI). The commit is not a move, revert, release tag, or squash aggregate. Tag check: BIC is an ancestor of affected v1.2.6; the confinement fix 18f5e478979bbb2606b1711289d410f89b1cffe9 is not in v1.2.6 and is in v1.2.7, which is the patched boundary.
